name: Valerie’s Taco Shop
notes: No dedicated restaurant website (worklist website is null); DoorDash marketplace listing for this exact address (6986 El Camino Real, Carlsbad) was used, server-rendered schema.org Menu JSON-LD. DoorDash lists the business as "Valeries Taco Stand" -- same address confirms same business as worklist name Valerie’s Taco Shop (a sibling Oceanside location, ordervaleriestacostand.com on MenuStar, was found and rejected as a different branch/address). Prices end mostly in .00/.25/.50/.75 with no consistent 1.1/1.15/1.2 divisor onto round numbers -- passes the markup test, read as genuine POS pricing rather than delivery markup. Grubhub listing for the same address returned only a JS shell with no prices (could not cross-check); Yelp 403d. 13 core sections captured: Tortas, Soft Tacos, Enchiladas, Rice Bowls, Crispy Tacos, Burritos, Flautas, Quesadillas, Chimichangas, Tostada, Breakfast Burritos, Combination Plates (a "Most Ordered" highlight section was dropped to avoid double-counting duplicate items). Kids Meals and a Sides/Drinks section referenced in a search summary were not present in DoorDash’s own JSON-LD and are treated as adjunct/missing-from-this-listing, not as evidence the capture is a partial of the core menu.

name: Kawaii Sushi
notes: Restaurant own site (kawaiisushisd.com) links directly to this MenuStar ordering platform as its Order Online / Menu page. Rendered HTML only held a JS shell (2 dollar signs); pulled the real catalog via the platform backend -- POST function=get_categories_by_menu to functions/restaurant.php returned 21 category ids, then POST function=get_items&id=<catid>&restaurant_id=261 per category returned the priced items. 211 dishes across all 21 categories, no item without a price. Prices end almost entirely in .95/.50/.75/.00, ordinary dine-in sushi-restaurant pricing with no clean 1.1/1.15/1.2 divisor onto round numbers -- passes the markup test. Categories: APPETIZERS, MEAT PLATE, BENTO, SOUP, FRIED RICE, YAKISOBA, DONBURI OR CURRY RICE, VEGETARIAN, NIGIRI, SASHIMI, SEAFOOD PLATE, SUSHI DELUXE, BASIC ROLLS, KAWAIIS RICE WRAPPED ROLL, TEMPURA ROLLS, BAKED ROLLS, FAVORITE ROLLS, SUPREME ROLLS, Smoothies/Milktea, SALAD, KIDS MEAL. A Popular Items highlight tab was skipped as a duplicate of items already listed under their real category.
